verses.1: When mankind began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them,
verses.2: the sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful, and they took as wives any they chose.
verses.3: Then the LORD said, "My Spirit will not remain with mankind forever, for they are flesh. Their days shall be 120 years."
verses.4: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of men and had children by them. These were the mighty men of old, the men of renown.
verses.5: The LORD saw that the wickedness of mankind was great on the earth, and that every intention of the thoughts of the human heart was only evil continually.
verses.6: The LORD regretted that He had made mankind on the earth, and it grieved Him to His heart.
verses.7: The LORD said, "I will blot out mankind whom I have created from the face of the earth — people, animals, crawling things, and birds of the sky — for I regret that I have made them."
verses.8: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.9: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.
verses.10: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.11: Now the earth was corrupt in God's sight, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.12: God looked at the earth and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its way on the earth.
verses.13: God said to Noah, "I have decided to bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. I am going to destroy them along with the earth.
verses.14: Build yourself an ark of gopher wood. Make rooms in the ark and coat it inside and out with pitch.
verses.15: This is how you are to build it: the ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.
verses.16: Make a roof for the ark and finish it to within a cubit of the top. Place a door in the side of the ark and make lower, middle, and upper decks.
verses.17: I am going to bring floodwaters on the earth to destroy all flesh that has the breath of life under the heavens. Everything on earth will perish.
verses.18: But I will establish My covenant with you. You will enter the ark — you and your sons and your wife and your sons' wives with you.
verses.19: You are to bring two of every living creature into the ark to keep them alive with you. They are to be male and female.
verses.20: Two of every kind of bird, every kind of animal, and every kind of creature that moves along the ground will come to you to be kept alive — a male and a female of each.
verses.21: Take with you every kind of food that can be eaten and store it up. It will serve as food for you and for them."
verses.22: Noah did this; he did everything God commanded him.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
